scope_note: Curated architecture and built-environment milestones for London, New York City, and Belfast from 2008-2026. This file is a reviewed seed layer for major named changes and does not claim exhaustive coverage of every building, permit, or design decision.
license_note: The file stores small factual event metadata, coordinates for atlas navigation, and source URLs. It does not reproduce publisher page text. Review each linked page before redistributing larger excerpts or media.
